<!-- ============================================================ FAILS -->
<section class="block" id="fails" aria-labelledby="h-fails">
<div class="wrap">
  <h2 id="h-fails">Where it fails</h2>
  <div class="prose"><p>Agreement cannot see a mistake most peers make. The three views below show that boundary on fresh sentences, in a controlled dose test, and on long legal definitions.</p></div>

  <div class="card view" id="v-shared">
    <h3 style="margin-top:0">When the majority is wrong</h3>
    <p class="q">What happens to agreement on sentences whose <button type="button" class="term" data-term="modal">modal cluster</button> is unfaithful?</p>
    <div class="controls">
      <div class="ctl-label"><span id="lab-sh">Panel items in sentences where the modal cluster is</span>
        <div class="seg" role="radiogroup" aria-labelledby="lab-sh" id="sh-split">
          <button type="button" role="radio" aria-checked="false" data-v="all">Any</button>
          <button type="button" role="radio" aria-checked="false" data-v="ok">Faithful</button>
          <button type="button" role="radio" aria-checked="true" data-v="bad">Unfaithful</button>
        </div></div>
      <label class="chk"><input type="checkbox" id="sh-list"> List the items agreement gets wrong here</label>
    </div>
    <div class="chart" id="c-shared" role="group" aria-label="AUROC in the selected split"></div>
    <p class="note">The modal cluster's correctness is read from the labels of its members (panel labels first, else solver labels), so this split is descriptive.</p>
    <div id="sh-items"></div>
    <p class="takeaway" id="sh-take" aria-live="polite"></p>
  </div>

  <div class="card view" id="v-dose">
    <h3 style="margin-top:0">The dose test</h3>
    <p class="q">How many peers must share a mistake before agreement prefers the mistake?</p>
    <p class="note">200 development sentences, 560 items over four operators: <em>k</em> of the eight peers are replaced by renamed copies of a mutant. Detection is the probability that the faithful formula scores above the mutant.</p>
    <div class="controls">
      <div class="ctl-label"><span id="lab-do">Peers replaced</span>
        <div class="seg" role="radiogroup" aria-labelledby="lab-do" id="do-order">
          <button type="button" role="radio" aria-checked="true" data-v="random">In random order</button>
          <button type="button" role="radio" aria-checked="false" data-v="faithful_first">Faithful peers first</button>
        </div></div>
      <label class="chk"><input type="checkbox" id="do-an" checked> Show the curve predicted from peer weight alone</label>
    </div>
    <div class="legend" id="do-legend"></div>
    <div class="chart" id="c-dose" role="group" aria-label="Detection by number of replaced peers"></div>
    <h4>On real development data</h4>
    <p class="note">Concordance within sentences, by the share of peer weight held by clusters with the wrong meaning (6,772 faithful × unfaithful pairs in 508 sentences, development configuration).</p>
    <div class="chart" id="c-real" role="group" aria-label="Within-sentence concordance by wrong-cluster weight share"></div>
    <p class="takeaway" id="do-take" aria-live="polite"></p>
  </div>

  <div class="card view" id="v-legal">
    <h3 style="margin-top:0">Long legal definitions</h3>
    <p class="q">Does agreement hold up on text rich in exceptions, where shared error is common?</p>
    <div class="controls">
      <label>Exception and condition markers<select id="lg-bin"><option value="all">All 158 sentences</option><option value="B0">0–1 markers</option><option value="B1">2–3 markers</option><option value="B2">4 or more markers</option></select></label>
    </div>
    <div class="chart" id="c-legal" role="group" aria-label="Weighted AUROC on the legal set"></div>
    <p class="note">Weighted AUROC against panel labels from the sentence alone (no gold exists). These are the weakest labels in the study: Fleiss κ 0.38 overall and 0.17 on sentences with four or more markers.</p>
    <p class="takeaway" id="lg-take" aria-live="polite"></p>
  </div>

  <div class="prose view">
    <h3>What the paper does not show</h3>
    <ul class="limits">
      <li><strong>A clear increment.</strong> Added to a base of judge, roundtrip and structural scores, peer agreement gains +0.033 AUROC on panel labels, 95% CI [−0.001, 0.066]. It is significant only under a directional test, on 256 panel items (Kish effective sample size 202).</li>
      <li><strong>A gain over an existing estimator.</strong> It does not beat binary Dawid–Skene agreement on panel labels (−0.003), and its gain over majority clustering comes from reliability weighting.</li>
      <li><strong>Human labels.</strong> Panel labels are LLM judgments, with Cohen κ 0.57 against human corrections on MALLS. No human adjudication was used.</li>
      <li><strong>Every baseline as specified.</strong> Roundtrip baselines on the fresh and legal sets used a local Qwen3-8B back-translation, and the frontier judge was not run on fresh items. GenV, FormalAlign and the relabelling framework of Brunello et al. were not benchmarked.</li>
      <li><strong>Separation within a sentence.</strong> On development solver labels, shuffling labels within sentences leaves the score at 0.70 AUROC against a true 0.82, so much of its item-level AUROC separates easy sentences from hard ones.</li>
      <li><strong>Error types.</strong> No reference-free method in the study named real error types better than always predicting the most frequent type.</li>
      <li><strong>A lone output.</strong> The score needs several independent systems per sentence; with a system's own samples as peers it reduces to self-consistency (0.842 against 0.843).</li>
    </ul>
  </div>
</div>
</section>
</main>

Recomputing every candidate's score from those relations reproduces the recorded score for all 4,050 rows.</li>

<!--DATA-->
<script>
"use strict";
(function(){
const J = id => JSON.parse(document.getElementById(id).textContent);
const F = J("data-fresh"), AGG = J("data-fresh-agg"), LEGAL = J("data-legal"), DOSE = J("data-dose"), VOCAB = J("data-vocab");
const $ = s => document.querySelector(s);
const SYS = F.systems, W = F.weights;
const SENT = {}; F.sentences.forEach(s => SENT[s.sid] = s);
const ITEMS = F.items;
ITEMS.forEach((it, i) => { it.i = i; it.si = SYS.indexOf(it.sys); });
const BYSID = {}; ITEMS.forEach(it => (BYSID[it.sid] = BYSID[it.sid] || []).push(it));
const RELNAME = F.rel_codes;
const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
const f3 = v => (v == null || isNaN(v)) ? "n/a" : v.toFixed(3);
const f2 = v => (v == null || isNaN(v)) ? "n/a" : v.toFixed(2);
const pct = v => (v == null || isNaN(v)) ? "n/a" : (100 * v).toFixed(1) + "%";
const esc = s => String(s == null ? "" : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;","'":"&#39;"}[c]));
const NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
const CORPUS = {malls:"MALLS", folio:"FOLIO v2 train", proverqa:"ProverQA"};
const ERR = {none:"none", added_condition:"added condition", quantifier_forall_exists:"∀/∃ choice", dropped_condition:"dropped condition",
  implication_direction_or_only:"implication direction or “only”", quantifier_scope:"quantifier scope", syntax_unparseable:"unparseable",
  connective_and_or:"and/or connective", conflation:"conflated concepts", wrong_constant:"wrong constant", negation_polarity:"negation or polarity",
  other:"other", argument_swap:"argument swap", wrong_split:"wrongly split concept"};

/* ---------------- weighted AUROC (ties count one half), identical to sklearn's roc_auc_score with sample_weight */
function wauc(rows){ // rows: [{x,y,w}]
  let P = 0, N = 0;
  rows.forEach(r => { if (r.y === 1) P += r.w; else N += r.w; });
  if (P <= 0 || N <= 0) return null;
  const s = rows.slice().sort((a, b) => b.x - a.x);
  let tp = 0, area = 0, i = 0;
  while (i < s.length){
    let j = i, gp = 0, gn = 0;
    while (j < s.length && s[j].x === s[i].x){ if (s[j].y === 1) gp += s[j].w; else gn += s[j].w; j++; }
    area += gn * (tp + gp / 2); tp += gp; i = j;
  }
  return area / (P * N);
}
const labOf = (it, fam) => fam === "P" ? it.yP : it.yS;
function rowsFor(items, key, fam){
  const out = [];
  items.forEach(it => {
    const y = labOf(it, fam); if (y == null) return;
    let x = it[key];
    if (x == null){ if (key === "NLI" || key === "COS") return; x = 0.5; }
    out.push({x, y, w: fam === "P" ? it.wP : 1});
  });
  return out;
}
const aucOf = (items, key, fam) => { const r = rowsFor(items, key, fam); return {auc: wauc(r), n: r.length, pos: r.filter(z => z.y === 1).length}; };

/* ---------------- modal cluster correctness per sentence (rule of experiment_3/src/s12_secondary.py) */
const MODEOK = {};
Object.keys(BYSID).forEach(sid => {
  const mm = BYSID[sid].filter(it => it.mode);
  const lp = mm.filter(it => it.yP != null).map(it => it.yP), ls = mm.filter(it => it.yS != null).map(it => it.yS);
  const mean = a => a.reduce((x, y) => x + y, 0) / a.length;
  if (lp.length) MODEOK[sid] = mean(lp) >= 0.5; else if (ls.length) MODEOK[sid] = mean(ls) >= 0.5;
});

/* ---------------- tooltips for chart marks */
const tip = $("#charttip");
function showTip(el, html){
  tip.innerHTML = html; tip.hidden = false;
  const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(), tw = tip.offsetWidth, th = tip.offsetHeight;
  let x = r.left + window.scrollX + r.width / 2 - tw / 2;
  x = Math.max(window.scrollX + 8, Math.min(x, window.scrollX + document.documentElement.clientWidth - tw - 8));
  let y = r.top + window.scrollY - th - 8;
  if (y < window.scrollY + 4) y = r.bottom + window.scrollY + 8;
  tip.style.left = x + "px"; tip.style.top = y + "px";
}
function hideTip(){ tip.hidden = true; }
function bindTip(g, html){
  g.setAttribute("tabindex", "0"); g.classList.add("mark");
  const on = () => showTip(g, html);
  g.addEventListener("mouseenter", on); g.addEventListener("focus", on); g.addEventListener("click", on);
  g.addEventListener("mouseleave", hideTip); g.addEventListener("blur", hideTip);
}
document.addEventListener("keydown", e => { if (e.key === "Escape"){ hideTip(); hideTerm(); } });
document.addEventListener("click", e => { if (!e.target.closest(".mark")) hideTip(); if (!e.target.closest(".term") && !e.target.closest("#termtip")) hideTerm(); });
window.addEventListener("scroll", () => { if (!tip.hidden && !document.activeElement.closest(".mark")) hideTip(); }, {passive:true});

function svgEl(tag, attrs, parent){ const e = document.createElementNS(NS, tag); for (const k in attrs) e.setAttribute(k, attrs[k]); if (parent) parent.appendChild(e); return e; }
function txt(parent, x, y, s, attrs){ const t = svgEl("text", Object.assign({x, y}, attrs || {}), parent); t.textContent = s; return t; }
const COL = {ours:"var(--accent)", base:"var(--base)", other:"var(--other)", ours2:"#6d95d3"};

/* ---------------- horizontal bar chart, AUROC on a 0..1 axis */
function hbars(host, groups, opt){
  opt = opt || {};
  host.innerHTML = "";
  const Wd = Math.max(300, host.clientWidth || 600), narrow = Wd < 560;
  const labW = narrow ? 0 : Math.min(250, Math.max(140, Wd * 0.33));
  const x0 = labW + (narrow ? 4 : 10), x1 = Wd - 58, bh = 16;
  const rowH = narrow ? 40 : 26, gTitle = 26;
  let h = 8; groups.forEach(g => { if (g.title) h += gTitle; h += g.rows.length * rowH + 6; });
  const H = h + 44;
  const svg = svgEl("svg", {viewBox:`0 0 ${Wd} ${H}`, width:Wd, height:H, role:"img", "aria-label": opt.label || "Bar chart"});
  const sx = v => x0 + (x1 - x0) * v;
  const ax = svgEl("g", {class:"axis"}, svg);
  [0, .25, .5, .75, 1].forEach(t => { svgEl("line", {x1:sx(t), x2:sx(t), y1:4, y2:h, class:"gridl"}, ax); txt(ax, sx(t), h + 16, t.toFixed(2), {"text-anchor":"middle"}); });
  svgEl("line", {x1:sx(.5), x2:sx(.5), y1:4, y2:h, stroke:"#8d939c", "stroke-dasharray":"4 3"}, ax);
  txt(ax, sx(.5) + 4, h - 3, "chance", {"font-size":"11"});
  txt(ax, (x0 + x1) / 2, h + 36, opt.xlabel || "AUROC (0.5 = chance, 1 = perfect ranking)", {"text-anchor":"middle", "font-size":"12.5", fill:"var(--ink)"});
  let y = 8;
  groups.forEach(g => {
    if (g.title){ txt(svg, 0, y + 17, g.title, {"font-size":"13.5", "font-weight":"700"}); y += gTitle; }
    g.rows.forEach(r => {
      const gy = narrow ? y + 18 : y + (rowH - bh) / 2;
      const lab = narrow ? txt(svg, x0, y + 13, r.label, {"font-size":"13"}) : txt(svg, labW, gy + 12.5, r.label, {"font-size":"13", "text-anchor":"end"});
      if (r.cls === "ours") lab.setAttribute("font-weight", "700");
      const mk = svgEl("g", {role:"img", "aria-label": `${r.label}: ${r.value == null ? "not computable" : f3(r.value)}`}, svg);
      if (r.value == null){
        svgEl("rect", {x:x0, y:gy, width:1, height:bh, fill:"transparent"}, mk);
        txt(mk, x0 + 4, gy + 12.5, r.na || "n/a: one label class only", {"font-size":"12", fill:"var(--ink2)"});
      } else {
        svgEl("rect", {x:x0, y:gy, width:Math.max(1, sx(r.value) - x0), height:bh, fill:COL[r.cls || "other"], rx:2}, mk);
        if (r.ci){
          svgEl("line", {x1:sx(r.ci[0]), x2:sx(r.ci[1]), y1:gy + bh / 2, y2:gy + bh / 2, stroke:"#1b1e24", "stroke-width":1.3}, mk);
          [0, 1].forEach(k => svgEl("line", {x1:sx(r.ci[k]), x2:sx(r.ci[k]), y1:gy + 3, y2:gy + bh - 3, stroke:"#1b1e24", "stroke-width":1.3}, mk));
        }
        txt(mk, Math.max(sx(r.value), r.ci ? sx(r.ci[1]) : 0) + 5, gy + 12.5, r.valText || f3(r.value), {"font-size":"12.5", "font-weight":"600"});
      }
      bindTip(mk, r.tip || `<b>${esc(r.label)}</b><br>${f3(r.value)}`);
      y += rowH;
    });
    y += 6;
  });
  host.appendChild(svg);
}

/* ---------------- segmented radio groups */
function radioGroup(id, onChange){
  const g = document.getElementById(id), bs = [...g.querySelectorAll("button")];
  const set = (b, focus) => { bs.forEach(x => { x.setAttribute("aria-checked", x === b ? "true" : "false"); x.tabIndex = x === b ? 0 : -1; }); if (focus) b.focus(); onChange(b.dataset.v); };
  bs.forEach((b, i) => {
    b.tabIndex = b.getAttribute("aria-checked") === "true" ? 0 : -1;
    b.addEventListener("click", () => set(b));
    b.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
      let j = null;
      if (e.key === "ArrowRight" || e.key === "ArrowDown") j = (i + 1) % bs.length;
      if (e.key === "ArrowLeft" || e.key === "ArrowUp") j = (i - 1 + bs.length) % bs.length;
      if (j != null){ e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); set(bs[j], true); }
    });
  });
  return () => g.querySelector('[aria-checked="true"]').dataset.v;
}

/* ================================================================ HEADLINE */
const SCORES = [
  {k:"DC", name:"Peer agreement (frozen)", cls:"ours", agg:"DC"},
  {k:"LCds", name:"Binary Dawid–Skene agreement", agg:"LC_ds_binary"},
  {k:"LCmaj", name:"Majority equivalence clustering", agg:"LC_maj"},
  {k:"B1", name:"LLM judge (gemini-2.5-flash)", cls:"base", agg:"B1"},
  {k:"NLI", name:"Roundtrip NLI (L)", agg:"B3nliL"},
  {k:"COS", name:"Roundtrip cosine (L)", agg:"B3cosL"},
  {k:"VC", name:"Vocabulary conformity control", agg:"VC"},
  {k:"B7", name:"Structural consistency metrics", agg:"B7"},
  {k:"B2", name:"Parse rate", agg:"B2"}];
const head = {fam:"P", corpus:"all", terc:"all"};
function drawHead(){
  const sel = ITEMS.filter(it => (head.corpus === "all" || SENT[it.sid].corpus === head.corpus) && (head.terc === "all" || SENT[it.sid].terc === head.terc));
  const unf = head.corpus === "all" && head.terc === "all";
  const fam = head.fam === "P" ? "panel" : "solver";
  const res = {};
  const rows = SCORES.map(s => {
    const a = aucOf(sel, s.k, head.fam); res[s.k] = a;
    const ag = unf ? AGG.auroc[s.agg + "|" + fam] : null;
    return {label:s.name, value:a.auc, cls:s.cls, ci: ag && a.auc != null ? ag.ci : null,
      tip:`<b>${esc(s.name)}</b><br>AUROC ${f3(a.auc)}${ag ? ` [${f3(ag.ci[0])}, ${f3(ag.ci[1])}]` : ""}<br>${a.n} labelled rows, ${a.pos} faithful${head.fam === "P" ? " (weighted)" : ""}`};
  });
  hbars($("#c-head"), [{rows}], {label:"AUROC of each score"});
  $("#head-note").textContent = unf ? "Whiskers: 95% intervals from a bootstrap clustered by sentence, as recorded by the run. Filtered views show point values computed here." :
    "Point values computed here from the filtered items; the recorded intervals cover only the unfiltered set.";
  const d = res.DC.auc, j = res.B1.auc;
  const where = (head.corpus === "all" ? "all three corpora" : CORPUS[head.corpus]) + (head.terc === "all" ? "" : `, ${head.terc} complexity tercile`);
  const lab = head.fam === "P" ? "panel labels" : "solver labels";
  let t;
  if (d == null || j == null) t = `This selection has only one label class under ${lab}, so no AUROC exists.`;
  else if (d > j) t = `On ${where} under ${lab} (${res.DC.n} rows), peer agreement ranks a faithful formula above an unfaithful one ${f3(d)} of the time; the judge does so ${f3(j)} of the time, ${f3(d - j)} lower.`;
  else t = `On ${where} under ${lab} (${res.DC.n} rows), the judge leads: ${f3(j)} against ${f3(d)} for peer agreement. Agreement's lead is not uniform.`;
  $("#head-take").textContent = t;
  if (unf && head.fam === "P"){ $("#big-pa").textContent = f3(d); $("#big-judge").textContent = f3(j); }
}
radioGroup("head-fam", v => { head.fam = v; drawHead(); });
$("#head-corpus").addEventListener("change", e => { head.corpus = e.target.value; drawHead(); });
$("#head-terc").addEventListener("change", e => { head.terc = e.target.value; drawHead(); });

/* ================================================================ relations, clusters, scores */
function relCode(sid, a, b){ const s = SENT[sid]; return s.rel[SYS.indexOf(a) * 9 + SYS.indexOf(b)]; }
function lvlCode(sid, a, b){ const s = SENT[sid]; return s.lvl[SYS.indexOf(a) * 9 + SYS.indexOf(b)]; }
function parseOk(sid, sys){ const it = BYSID[sid].find(z => z.sys === sys); return it && it.parse; }
function clusters(sid){
  const ok = SYS.filter(s => parseOk(sid, s)), parent = {};
  ok.forEach(s => parent[s] = s);
  const find = a => { while (parent[a] !== a){ parent[a] = parent[parent[a]]; a = parent[a]; } return a; };
  ok.forEach(a => ok.forEach(b => { if (a !== b && relCode(sid, a, b) === "E"){ const ra = find(a), rb = find(b); if (ra !== rb) parent[ra < rb ? rb : ra] = ra < rb ? ra : rb; } }));
  const groups = {}; ok.forEach(s => (groups[find(s)] = groups[find(s)] || []).push(s));
  const list = Object.values(groups).map(m => ({members:m, weight:m.reduce((x, s) => x + W[s], 0)}));
  list.sort((a, b) => b.weight - a.weight || SYS.indexOf(a.members[0]) - SYS.indexOf(b.members[0]));
  return list;
}
function score(sid, cand, peers, weights){
  // peer agreement exactly as dc/consensus.py score_group: covered peers are parseable, relation not UNKNOWN
  if (!parseOk(sid, cand)) return {score:0.5, covered:false, num:0, den:0, n:0, reason:"unparseable candidate"};
  let num = 0, den = 0, n = 0;
  peers.forEach(p => {
    if (p === cand || !parseOk(sid, p)) return;
    const c = relCode(sid, cand, p); if (c === "?") return;
    n++; den += weights[p]; if (c === "E") num += weights[p];
  });
  if (n < 2 || den <= 0) return {score:0.5, covered:false, num, den, n, reason:"fewer than two covered peers"};
  return {score:num / den, covered:true, num, den, n};
}
const relChip = c => c === "-" ? `<span class="chip na">not compared</span>` : `<span class="chip ${c === "E" ? "E" : ""}">${esc(RELNAME[c] || c)}</span>`;
const labChip = y => y == null ? `<span class="chip na">no label</span>` : y === 1 ? `<span class="chip fa">faithful</span>` : `<span class="chip un">unfaithful</span>`;
const itemOf = (sid, sys) => BYSID[sid].find(z => z.sys === sys);

/* ================================================================ STEPPER */
const EX = F.example_sid, EXS = SENT[EX];
const STAGES = [
  {name:"Outputs", long:"Collect the outputs"}, {name:"Align", long:"Align vocabularies"}, {name:"Relate", long:"Solve each pair"},
  {name:"Cluster", long:"Form equivalence clusters"}, {name:"Weigh", long:"Weight each system"}, {name:"Score", long:"Weighted share of EQUIV peers"}];
let stage = 0, stCand = "gpt-4.1-mini";
const stSel = $("#st-cand");
SYS.forEach(s => { const o = document.createElement("option"); o.value = s; o.textContent = s; stSel.appendChild(o); });
stSel.value = stCand;
stSel.addEventListener("change", () => { stCand = stSel.value; renderStage(); });
function drawPipe(){
  const host = $("#pipe"); host.innerHTML = "";
  const Wd = Math.max(300, host.clientWidth || 700), two = Wd < 620, per = two ? 3 : 6;
  const bw = (Wd - (per - 1) * 16) / per, bhh = 44, H = two ? 2 * bhh + 22 : bhh + 8;
  const svg = svgEl("svg", {viewBox:`0 0 ${Wd} ${H}`, width:Wd, height:H, role:"group", "aria-label":"Pipeline: six stages"});
  STAGES.forEach((st, i) => {
    const r = Math.floor(i / per), c = i % per, x = c * (bw + 16), y = r * (bhh + 18) + 2;
    if (c < per - 1 && i < STAGES.length - 1) svgEl("path", {d:`M${x + bw + 2} ${y + bhh / 2} l10 0 m-4 -4 l4 4 l-4 4`, stroke:"#8d939c", fill:"none", "stroke-width":1.5}, svg);
    const g = svgEl("g", {class:"st" + (i === stage ? " cur" : i < stage ? " done" : ""), tabindex:"0", role:"button", "aria-label":`Stage ${i + 1}: ${st.long}`}, svg);
    if (i === stage) g.setAttribute("aria-current", "step");
    svgEl("rect", {x, y, width:bw, height:bhh, rx:8}, g);
    txt(g, x + bw / 2, y + bhh / 2 + 5, `${i + 1}. ${st.name}`, {"text-anchor":"middle"});
    g.addEventListener("click", () => go(i));
    g.addEventListener("keydown", e => { if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " "){ e.preventDefault(); go(i); } });
  });
  host.appendChild(svg);
}
function go(i){ stage = Math.max(0, Math.min(STAGES.length - 1, i)); renderStage(true); }
$("#st-prev").addEventListener("click", () => go(stage - 1));
$("#st-next").addEventListener("click", () => go(stage + 1));
$("#stepper").addEventListener("keydown", e => {
  if (e.target.tagName === "SELECT") return;
  if (e.key === "ArrowRight"){ e.preventDefault(); go(stage + 1); } else if (e.key === "ArrowLeft"){ e.preventDefault(); go(stage - 1); }
});
function mapText(a, b){
  const m = F.example_maps[a + "|" + b]; if (!m || !m.map) return "";
  const ca = itemOf(EX, a).cand;
  return Object.entries(m.map).map(([k, v]) => {
    const K = k.replace(/^#/, ""), V = v.replace(/^#/, "");
    const left = ca.includes(K) ? K : V, right = left === K ? V : K;
    return `${esc(left)} ↔ ${esc(right)}`;
  }).join(", ");
}
function renderStage(announce){
  drawPipe();
  const cand = stCand, peers = SYS.filter(s => s !== cand), ci = itemOf(EX, cand);
  const body = $("#st-body");
  let h = `<h3 style="margin-top:14px">Stage ${stage + 1} of 6: ${STAGES[stage].long}</h3>`, take = "";
  const res = score(EX, cand, SYS, W);
  const cl = clusters(EX);
  if (stage === 0){
    h += `<div class="stage-grid"><div class="io"><b>In</b>The sentence, given to each of nine LLMs with one zero-shot prompt at temperature 0.</div><div class="io"><b>Done</b>Each system names its own predicates. The score will read only the formulas.</div><div class="io"><b>Out</b>Nine formulas, ${BYSID[EX].filter(z => z.parse).length} parseable.</div></div>`;
    h += `<p class="fol" style="font-family:var(--font);font-size:17px">“${esc(EXS.text)}”</p><div class="tscroll"><table><thead><tr><th>System</th><th>Formula</th></tr></thead><tbody>`;
    SYS.forEach(s => { const it = itemOf(EX, s); h += `<tr${s === cand ? ' style="background:var(--accent-soft)"' : ""}><td>${esc(s)}${s === cand ? " <b>(candidate)</b>" : ""}</td><td><span class="fol" style="display:block;margin:0">${esc(it.cand)}</span></td></tr>`; });
    h += `</tbody></table></div>`;
    const distinct = new Set(BYSID[EX].map(z => z.cand.replace(/\s+/g, "").toLowerCase())).size;
    take = `The nine outputs fall into ${distinct} distinct spellings even before any logic is checked; string match would call most of them different.`;
  } else if (stage === 1){
    h += `<div class="stage-grid"><div class="io"><b>In</b>The candidate (${esc(cand)}) and each peer.</div><div class="io"><b>Done</b>Search for a map of predicates and constants that uses structure only: first an arity-preserving bijection, then a partial map covering at least 50% of the peer's predicate occurrences.</div><div class="io"><b>Out</b>For each peer, the level at which a map was admissible and the map the solver kept.</div></div>`;
    h += `<div class="tscroll"><table><thead><tr><th>Peer</th><th>Level</th><th>Map kept (candidate ↔ peer)</th></tr></thead><tbody>`;
    peers.forEach(p => { const l = lvlCode(EX, cand, p); const lv = l === "1" ? "bijection" : l === "2" ? "partial map" : relCode(EX, cand, p) === "U" ? "no admissible map" : "n/a";
      h += `<tr><td>${esc(p)}</td><td>${lv}</td><td style="font-family:var(--mono);font-size:13.5px">${mapText(cand, p) || "identical string or not recorded"}</td></tr>`; });
    h += `</tbody></table></div>`;
    const nb = peers.filter(p => lvlCode(EX, cand, p) === "1").length, np = peers.filter(p => lvlCode(EX, cand, p) === "2").length;
    take = `${nb} peers align to ${cand} by a full bijection and ${np} only by a partial map. Case differences such as cpsc201 and CPSC201 are handled by the map, not by reading the names.`;
  } else if (stage === 2){
    h += `<div class="stage-grid"><div class="io"><b>In</b>Each aligned pair.</div><div class="io"><b>Done</b>Truth values on 64 fixed random finite structures of size 2 and 3 refute equivalence cheaply; undecided pairs go to an unbounded Z3 query, then grounding up to size 3.</div><div class="io"><b>Out</b>One relation per pair: EQUIV, STRONGER, WEAKER, INCOMPARABLE, CONTRADICTORY or UNALIGNABLE.</div></div>`;
    h += `<div class="tscroll"><table><thead><tr><th>Peer</th><th>Relation of ${esc(cand)} to the peer</th><th>Peer formula</th></tr></thead><tbody>`;
    peers.forEach(p => { h += `<tr><td>${esc(p)}</td><td>${relChip(relCode(EX, cand, p))}</td><td><span class="fol" style="display:block;margin:0">${esc(itemOf(EX, p).cand)}</span></td></tr>`; });
    h += `</tbody></table></div>`;
    const ne = peers.filter(p => relCode(EX, cand, p) === "E").length;
    take = `The solver proves ${ne} of 8 peers equivalent to ${cand}. A formula that drops “Student” comes out as a strictly different relation, even though every name matches.`;
  } else if (stage === 3){
    h += `<div class="stage-grid"><div class="io"><b>In</b>All pairwise relations among the nine outputs.</div><div class="io"><b>Done</b>EQUIV links outputs into clusters (connected components).</div><div class="io"><b>Out</b>Clusters of outputs with the same meaning; the heaviest is the <button type="button" class="term" data-term="modal">modal cluster</button>.</div></div>`;
    h += `<div class="tscroll"><table><thead><tr><th>Cluster</th><th>Members</th><th class="num">Peer weight</th><th>Representative formula</th></tr></thead><tbody>`;
    cl.forEach((c, k) => { h += `<tr${c.members.includes(cand) ? ' style="background:var(--accent-soft)"' : ""}><td>${k === 0 ? "modal" : "#" + (k + 1)}</td><td>${c.members.map(esc).join(", ")}</td><td class="num">${c.weight.toFixed(3)}</td><td><span class="fol" style="display:block;margin:0">${esc(itemOf(EX, c.members[0]).cand)}</span></td></tr>`; });
    h += `</tbody></table></div>`;
    take = `${cl.length} meaning clusters. ${cand} sits in ${cl.findIndex(c => c.members.includes(cand)) === 0 ? "the modal cluster" : "a minority cluster"}.`;
    setTimeout(bindTerms, 0);
  } else if (stage === 4){
    h += `<div class="stage-grid"><div class="io"><b>In</b>The EQUIV clusters of all 450 fresh sentences, without any label.</div><div class="io"><b>Done</b>A one-coin Dawid–Skene model fits one accuracy per system; weights are floored at 0.05.</div><div class="io"><b>Out</b>One reliability weight per system, shared by every sentence.</div></div>`;
    const mx = Math.max(...SYS.map(s => W[s]));
    h += `<div class="tscroll"><table><thead><tr><th>System</th><th class="num">Weight</th><th style="width:45%">Relative</th></tr></thead><tbody>`;
    SYS.slice().sort((a, b) => W[b] - W[a]).forEach(s => { h += `<tr><td>${esc(s)}</td><td class="num">${W[s].toFixed(3)}</td><td><span class="wbar" style="width:${(100 * W[s] / mx).toFixed(1)}%"></span></td></tr>`; });
    h += `</tbody></table></div>`;
    const top = SYS.slice().sort((a, b) => W[b] - W[a])[0], floor = SYS.filter(s => W[s] <= 0.05 + 1e-9).length;
    take = `${top} earns the largest weight; ${floor} of nine systems sit at the 0.05 floor, so their votes barely count.`;
  } else {
    const agree = peers.filter(p => relCode(EX, cand, p) === "E");
    h += `<div class="stage-grid"><div class="io"><b>In</b>The relations of the candidate to its peers and the weights.</div><div class="io"><b>Done</b>Sum the weights of EQUIV peers and divide by the weights of all covered peers (UNALIGNABLE peers count in the denominator).</div><div class="io"><b>Out</b>A score in [0, 1]. Unparseable candidates get 0.5.</div></div>`;
    h += `<p class="calc">PA(${esc(cand)}) = <span class="frac"><span>Σ<sub>EQUIV peers</sub> w<sub>j</sub> = ${res.num.toFixed(3)}</span><span>Σ<sub>covered peers</sub> w<sub>j</sub> = ${res.den.toFixed(3)}</span></span> = <b>${res.score.toFixed(3)}</b></p>`;
    h += `<p>EQUIV peers: ${agree.length ? agree.map(esc).join(", ") : "none"}.</p>`;
    h += `<div class="scorebox"><div><div class="k">Recomputed here</div><div class="v" style="color:var(--accent)">${res.score.toFixed(3)}</div></div><div><div class="k">Recorded by the run</div><div class="v">${ci.DC.toFixed(3)}</div></div><div><div class="k">LLM judge</div><div class="v" style="color:var(--base)">${f2(ci.B1)}</div></div><div><div class="k">Panel label</div><div class="v" style="font-size:16px">${labChip(ci.yP)}${ci.err && ci.err !== "none" ? " " + esc(ERR[ci.err] || ci.err) : ""}</div></div><div><div class="k">Solver label</div><div class="v" style="font-size:16px">${labChip(ci.yS)}</div></div></div>`;
    const judgeFlat = new Set(BYSID[EX].map(z => z.B1)).size === 1;
    take = `${cand} scores ${res.score.toFixed(3)}${Math.abs(res.score - ci.DC) < 1e-5 ? ", exactly the recorded value" : ""}.` + (judgeFlat ? ` The judge gives every one of the nine outputs ${f2(ci.B1)}, so it cannot separate them; agreement can.` : "") +
      (ci.yS === 0 && ci.yP === 1 ? " Note the solver label calls this output unfaithful while the panel calls it faithful: a correct formula need not be equivalent to the audited gold." : "");
  }
  body.innerHTML = h;
  $("#st-take").textContent = take;
  $("#st-prev").disabled = stage === 0; $("#st-next").disabled = stage === STAGES.length - 1;
  $("#st-count").textContent = `Stage ${stage + 1} of ${STAGES.length}`;
  if (announce) $("#st-live").textContent = `Stage ${stage + 1} of ${STAGES.length}: ${STAGES[stage].long}`;
  bindTerms();
}

/* ================================================================ ITEM BROWSER */
const bsys = $("#b-sys"); SYS.forEach(s => { const o = document.createElement("option"); o.value = s; o.textContent = s; bsys.appendChild(o); });
const B = {set:"P", lab:"any", sys:"all", corpus:"all", sort:"gapJ", q:"", dis:false, shown:50, sel:null};
function bLabel(it){ return B.set === "S" ? it.yS : B.set === "P" ? it.yP : (it.yP != null ? it.yP : it.yS); }
function bFilter(){
  const q = B.q.trim().toLowerCase();
  let L = ITEMS.filter(it => {
    if (B.set === "P" && it.yP == null) return false;
    if (B.set === "S" && it.yS == null) return false;
    const y = bLabel(it);
    if (B.lab !== "any" && String(y) !== B.lab) return false;
    if (B.sys !== "all" && it.sys !== B.sys) return false;
    if (B.corpus !== "all" && SENT[it.sid].corpus !== B.corpus) return false;
    if (B.dis && Math.abs(it.DC - it.B1) < 0.5) return false;
    if (q && !(SENT[it.sid].text.toLowerCase().includes(q) || it.cand.toLowerCase().includes(q))) return false;
    return true;
  });
  const key = {gapJ: it => it.DC - it.B1, gapA: it => it.B1 - it.DC, lo: it => it.DC, hi: it => -it.DC}[B.sort];
  L.sort((a, b) => key(a) - key(b) || a.i - b.i);
  return L;
}
function drawBrowser(keepSel){
  const L = bFilter(), ul = $("#b-list"); ul.innerHTML = "";
  const nf = L.filter(it => bLabel(it) === 1).length;
  $("#b-count").textContent = `${L.length} matching items (${nf} faithful, ${L.length - nf - L.filter(it => bLabel(it) == null).length} unfaithful${L.some(it => bLabel(it) == null) ? ", " + L.filter(it => bLabel(it) == null).length + " unlabelled" : ""}). Showing ${Math.min(B.shown, L.length)}.`;
  L.slice(0, B.shown).forEach(it => {
    const li = document.createElement("li"), b = document.createElement("button");
    b.type = "button"; b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(B.sel === it.i));
    b.innerHTML = `<span class="s">${esc(SENT[it.sid].text)}</span><span class="m">${labChip(bLabel(it))}<span>${esc(it.sys)}</span><span>agreement <b>${f2(it.DC)}</b></span><span>judge <b>${f2(it.B1)}</b></span></span>`;
    b.addEventListener("click", () => { B.sel = it.i; ul.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(x => x.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "false")); b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "true"); drawDetail(); });
    li.appendChild(b); ul.appendChild(li);
  });
  $("#b-more").hidden = L.length <= B.shown;
  if (!keepSel || B.sel == null || !L.some(it => it.i === B.sel)){ B.sel = L.length ? L[0].i : null; const fb = ul.querySelector("button"); if (fb) fb.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "true"); }
  drawDetail();
}
function drawDetail(){
  const d = $("#b-detail");
  if (B.sel == null){ d.innerHTML = `<p class="note">No item matches these filters.</p>`; $("#b-take").textContent = "Loosen a filter to see items."; return; }
  const it = ITEMS[B.sel], s = SENT[it.sid], cl = clusters(it.sid);
  const modal = cl.length ? cl[0] : null;
  let rep = null;
  if (modal){ const others = modal.members.filter(m => m !== it.sys).sort((a, b) => W[b] - W[a]); rep = others[0] || null; }
  let h = `<p class="note" style="margin:0">${esc(CORPUS[s.corpus])} · ${esc(s.terc)} complexity tercile · ${s.tok} tokens · ${s.q} quantifiers · ${s.cond} conditions</p>`;
  h += `<p class="fol" style="font-family:var(--font);font-size:17px">“${esc(s.text)}”</p>`;
  h += `<div class="scorebox"><div><div class="k">Peer agreement</div><div class="v" style="color:var(--accent)">${f3(it.DC)}</div></div><div><div class="k">LLM judge</div><div class="v" style="color:var(--base)">${f2(it.B1)}</div></div><div><div class="k">Panel label</div><div class="v" style="font-size:15px">${labChip(it.yP)}${it.err && it.err !== "none" ? "<br>" + esc(ERR[it.err] || it.err) : ""}</div></div><div><div class="k">Solver label</div><div class="v" style="font-size:15px">${labChip(it.yS)}</div></div></div>`;
  h += `<div class="cols3"><div><h4>Candidate (${esc(it.sys)})</h4><div class="fol">${esc(it.cand || "(empty output)")}</div>${it.parse ? "" : '<p class="note">Unparseable: scored 0.5 and kept.</p>'}</div>`;
  h += `<div><h4>What most peers wrote</h4>${rep ? `<div class="fol">${esc(itemOf(it.sid, rep).cand)}</div><p class="note">${esc(rep)}, modal cluster (${modal.members.length} outputs${modal.members.includes(it.sys) ? ", candidate included" : ""})</p>` : '<p class="note">No other member in the modal cluster.</p>'}</div>`;
  h += `<div><h4>Audited gold</h4><div class="fol">${esc(s.gold || "(no audited gold)")}</div><p class="note">${s.gold_src === "original" ? "Shipped gold passed the panel audit." : "Gold replaced or corrected by the panel audit."}</p></div></div>`;
  h += `<h4>Relation to each peer</h4><div class="tscroll"><table><thead><tr><th>Peer</th><th class="num">Weight</th><th>Relation</th><th>Peer's own score</th></tr></thead><tbody>`;
  SYS.filter(p => p !== it.sys).forEach(p => { const pi = itemOf(it.sid, p); h += `<tr><td>${esc(p)}</td><td class="num">${W[p].toFixed(3)}</td><td>${it.parse && pi.parse ? relChip(relCode(it.sid, it.sys, p)) : '<span class="chip na">unparseable</span>'}</td><td>${f3(pi.DC)}</td></tr>`; });
  h += `</tbody></table></div>`;
  d.innerHTML = h;
  const y = bLabel(it);
  let t = `Agreement says ${f2(it.DC)}, the judge ${f2(it.B1)}; `;
  if (y == null) t += "no label exists for this item.";
  else {
    const aRight = (it.DC >= 0.5) === (y === 1), jRight = (it.B1 >= 0.5) === (y === 1);
    t += `the label is ${y === 1 ? "faithful" : "unfaithful"}. At a 0.5 cut, ${aRight && jRight ? "both scores are right" : aRight ? "agreement is right and the judge is wrong" : jRight ? "the judge is right and agreement is wrong" : "both scores are wrong"}.`;
    if (!aRight && MODEOK[it.sid] === false) t += " The modal cluster of this sentence is unfaithful, the regime where agreement fails.";
  }
  $("#b-take").textContent = t;
}
[["b-set","set"],["b-lab","lab"],["b-sys","sys"],["b-corpus","corpus"],["b-sort","sort"]].forEach(([id, k]) => $("#" + id).addEventListener("change", e => { B[k] = e.target.value; B.shown = 50; drawBrowser(); }));
$("#b-q").addEventListener("input", e => { B.q = e.target.value; B.shown = 50; drawBrowser(); });
$("#b-dis").addEventListener("change", e => { B.dis = e.target.checked; B.shown = 50; drawBrowser(); });
$("#b-more").addEventListener("click", () => { B.shown += 50; drawBrowser(true); });
function openInBrowser(i){
  const it = ITEMS[i];
  Object.assign(B, {set:"P", lab:"any", sys:"all", corpus:"all", q:"", dis:false, sort:"gapJ", shown:4050, sel:i});
  $("#b-set").value = "P"; $("#b-lab").value = "any"; $("#b-sys").value = "all"; $("#b-corpus").value = "all"; $("#b-q").value = ""; $("#b-dis").checked = false; $("#b-sort").value = "gapJ";
  B.q = SENT[it.sid].text.slice(0, 40); $("#b-q").value = B.q;
  drawBrowser(true);
  $("#v-browser").scrollIntoView({behavior: reduceMotion ? "auto" : "smooth"});
  const btn = $('#b-list button[aria-pressed="true"]'); if (btn) btn.focus({preventScroll:true});
}

/* ================================================================ COMPLEXITY */
const CXB = {
  tok:[["≤12 tokens", v => v <= 12], ["13–20 tokens", v => v >= 13 && v <= 20], [">20 tokens", v => v > 20]],
  q:[["0 quantifiers", v => v === 0], ["1 quantifier", v => v === 1], ["2+ quantifiers", v => v >= 2]],
  nest:[["depth ≤3", v => v <= 3], ["depth 4–5", v => v >= 4 && v <= 5], ["depth 6+", v => v >= 6]],
  cond:[["0–1 conditions", v => v <= 1], ["2 conditions", v => v === 2], ["3+ conditions", v => v >= 3]],
  terc:[["bottom tercile", v => v === "bottom"], ["middle tercile", v => v === "middle"], ["top tercile", v => v === "top"]]};
const cx = {feat:"tok", fam:"P"};
function drawCx(){
  const groups = [], leads = [];
  CXB[cx.feat].forEach(([name, fn]) => {
    const sel = ITEMS.filter(it => fn(SENT[it.sid][cx.feat]));
    const a = aucOf(sel, "DC", cx.fam), j = aucOf(sel, "B1", cx.fam);
    const title = `${name} (${a.n} items, ${a.pos} faithful)`;
    groups.push({title, rows:[
      {label:"Peer agreement", value:a.auc, cls:"ours", tip:`<b>${esc(name)}</b><br>Peer agreement AUROC ${f3(a.auc)}<br>${a.n} items, ${a.pos} faithful`},
      {label:"LLM judge", value:j.auc, cls:"base", tip:`<b>${esc(name)}</b><br>LLM judge AUROC ${f3(j.auc)}<br>${a.n} items, ${a.pos} faithful`}]});
    if (a.auc != null && j.auc != null) leads.push({name, d:a.auc - j.auc, n:a.n});
  });
  hbars($("#c-cx"), groups, {label:"AUROC per complexity stratum"});
  const win = leads.filter(l => l.d > 0), lose = leads.filter(l => l.d <= 0);
  let t = `Under ${cx.fam === "P" ? "panel" : "solver"} labels, agreement leads the judge in ${win.length} of ${leads.length} strata`;
  if (lose.length) t += ` and trails on ${lose.map(l => `${l.name} (${l.d >= 0 ? "+" : "−"}${Math.abs(l.d).toFixed(3)}, n = ${l.n})`).join(", ")}.`; else t += ".";
  if (cx.fam === "P" && lose.length) t += " Strata of a few dozen panel items carry wide intervals, so read these as descriptive.";
  $("#cx-take").textContent = t;
}
$("#cx-feat").addEventListener("change", e => { cx.feat = e.target.value; drawCx(); });
radioGroup("cx-fam", v => { cx.fam = v; drawCx(); });

/* ================================================================ VOCABULARY */
const VNAMES = [["DC_L2w", "Peer agreement, no granularity definitions", "ours"], ["LC_maj_star", "Majority equivalence clustering", "other"], ["B1", "LLM judge (gemini-2.5-flash)", "base"], ["VC", "Vocabulary conformity control", "other"]];
const ARMN = {conf:"the modal peer's names", tok:"random tokens", syn:"WordNet synonyms", crossed:"the crossed rendering"};
let voArm = "conf";
function drawVocab(){
  const A = VOCAB.arms[voArm];
  hbars($("#c-vocab"), [{rows: VNAMES.map(([k, n, c]) => ({label:n, value:A[k].auc, cls:c, ci:A[k].ci,
    tip:`<b>${esc(n)}</b><br>AUROC ${f3(A[k].auc)} [${f3(A[k].ci[0])}, ${f3(A[k].ci[1])}]<br>${A[k].nF} faithful vs ${A[k].nM} mutants`}))}], {label:"AUROC, faithful against mutants", xlabel:"AUROC, faithful formula against its mutants"});
  const j0 = VOCAB.arms.conf.B1.auc, j = A.B1.auc, d0 = VOCAB.arms.conf.DC_L2w.auc, d = A.DC_L2w.auc;
  $("#vo-take").textContent = voArm === "conf" ? `With conventional names every score except the conformity control separates faithful formulas from mutants; the judge reaches ${f3(j0)}, agreement ${f3(d0)}.` :
    `Rendered in ${ARMN[voArm]}, agreement stays at ${f3(d)} (change ${(d - d0).toFixed(3)}), while the judge moves from ${f3(j0)} to ${f3(j)}` + (voArm === "crossed" ? ` and the conformity control collapses to ${f3(A.VC.auc)}.` : ".");
}
radioGroup("vo-arm", v => { voArm = v; drawVocab(); });

/* ================================================================ RECOMPUTE */
const kSids = Object.keys(BYSID).filter(sid => BYSID[sid].some(it => it.yP != null));
kSids.sort((a, b) => SENT[a].text.localeCompare(SENT[b].text));
const kSel = $("#k-sent");
kSids.forEach(sid => { const o = document.createElement("option"); o.value = sid; const t = SENT[sid].text; o.textContent = t.length > 90 ? t.slice(0, 88) + "…" : t; kSel.appendChild(o); });
const K = {sid:EX, cand:null, peers:new Set(SYS), wmode:"ds", base:null};
let kSeed = 20240917;
function kRand(){ kSeed = (kSeed * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2147483648; return kSeed / 2147483648; }
function kSetSentence(sid){
  K.sid = sid; kSel.value = sid; K.peers = new Set(SYS);
  const lab = BYSID[sid].filter(it => it.yP != null && it.parse);
  K.cand = (lab[0] || BYSID[sid].find(it => it.parse) || BYSID[sid][0]).sys;
  K.base = null; drawCalc();
}
function drawCalc(){
  const sid = K.sid, s = SENT[sid], wts = K.wmode === "ds" ? W : Object.fromEntries(SYS.map(x => [x, 1]));
  $("#k-text").textContent = "“" + s.text + "”";
  const tb = $("#k-table tbody"); tb.innerHTML = "";
  SYS.forEach(sys => {
    const it = itemOf(sid, sys), tr = document.createElement("tr");
    const isC = sys === K.cand;
    tr.innerHTML = `<td><input type="radio" name="k-cand" aria-label="Use ${esc(sys)} as candidate" ${isC ? "checked" : ""} ${it.parse ? "" : "disabled"} style="width:22px;height:22px;accent-color:var(--accent)"></td>
      <td><input type="checkbox" aria-label="Count ${esc(sys)} as a peer" ${K.peers.has(sys) ? "checked" : ""} ${isC || !it.parse ? "disabled" : ""} style="width:22px;height:22px;accent-color:var(--accent)"></td>
      <td>${esc(sys)}</td><td class="num">${wts[sys].toFixed(3)}</td><td><span class="fol" style="display:block;margin:0;font-size:13px">${esc(it.cand || "(empty)")}</span></td>
      <td>${isC ? "<b>candidate</b>" : !it.parse ? '<span class="chip na">unparseable</span>' : itemOf(sid, K.cand).parse ? relChip(relCode(sid, K.cand, sys)) : '<span class="chip na">n/a</span>'}</td>`;
    if (isC) tr.style.background = "var(--accent-soft)";
    tr.querySelector('input[type=radio]').addEventListener("change", () => { K.cand = sys; K.base = null; drawCalc(); });
    tr.querySelector('input[type=checkbox]').addEventListener("change", e => { if (e.target.checked) K.peers.add(sys); else K.peers.delete(sys); drawCalc(); });
    tb.appendChild(tr);
  });
  const peers = SYS.filter(x => x !== K.cand && K.peers.has(x));
  const r = score(sid, K.cand, peers, wts), ci = itemOf(sid, K.cand);
  const full = peers.length === 8 && K.wmode === "ds";
  if (full) K.base = r.score;
  const baseRec = ci.DC;
  let h = `<p>PA(${esc(K.cand)}) = <span class="frac"><span>${r.num.toFixed(3)}</span><span>${r.den.toFixed(3)}</span></span> = <b style="font-size:22px;color:var(--accent)">${r.covered ? r.score.toFixed(3) : "0.500"}</b>${r.covered ? "" : ` (${esc(r.reason)}: the score defaults to 0.5)`}</p>`;
  h += `<p style="font-size:15.5px">Recorded score with all eight peers and Dawid–Skene weights: <b>${f3(baseRec)}</b>${full ? (Math.abs(r.score - baseRec) < 1e-5 ? ' <span class="ok">(reproduced exactly)</span>' : "") : ""}. Judge ${f2(ci.B1)}. Panel label ${labChip(ci.yP)} · solver label ${labChip(ci.yS)}</p>`;
  $("#k-out").innerHTML = h;
  let t;
  if (full) t = `With every peer voting and the fitted weights, ${K.cand} scores ${r.score.toFixed(3)}, the value the run recorded. Untick peers or switch to uniform weights to see how much the score leans on them.`;
  else t = `With ${peers.length} of 8 peers and ${K.wmode === "ds" ? "Dawid–Skene" : "uniform"} weights, ${K.cand} scores ${r.covered ? r.score.toFixed(3) : "0.500 (not covered)"}, against ${f3(baseRec)} recorded (change ${r.covered ? ((r.score - baseRec) >= 0 ? "+" : "−") + Math.abs(r.score - baseRec).toFixed(3) : "n/a"}).`;
  $("#k-take").textContent = t;
}
kSel.addEventListener("change", () => kSetSentence(kSel.value));
$("#k-rand").addEventListener("click", () => kSetSentence(kSids[Math.floor(kRand() * kSids.length)]));
radioGroup("k-w", v => { K.wmode = v; drawCalc(); });

/* ================================================================ THRESHOLD / ROC */
const T = {t:0.5, fam:"P"};
function flagStats(rows, t){ // flag if score < t; positives for catching = unfaithful
  let fu = 0, ff = 0, U = 0, Fa = 0;
  rows.forEach(r => { if (r.y === 0){ U += r.w; if (r.x < t) fu += r.w; } else { Fa += r.w; if (r.x < t) ff += r.w; } });
  return {catch: U ? fu / U : null, fa: Fa ? ff / Fa : null, share: (fu + ff) / (U + Fa), prec: (fu + ff) > 0 ? fu / (fu + ff) : null};
}
function rocPts(rows){
  const th = [...new Set(rows.map(r => r.x))].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const pts = [{fa:0, catch:0}];
  th.forEach(v => { const s = flagStats(rows, v + 1e-9); pts.push({fa:s.fa, catch:s.catch}); });
  return pts;
}
function drawThr(){
  $("#t-val").textContent = T.t.toFixed(2);
  const rd = rowsFor(ITEMS, "DC", T.fam), rj = rowsFor(ITEMS, "B1", T.fam);
  const sd = flagStats(rd, T.t);
  // judge threshold whose flagged share is closest to agreement's
  const jth = [...new Set(rj.map(r => r.x))].sort((a, b) => a - b).map(v => v + 1e-9); jth.unshift(0);
  let best = null;
  jth.forEach(u => { const s = flagStats(rj, u); if (!best || Math.abs(s.share - sd.share) < Math.abs(best.s.share - sd.share)) best = {u, s}; });
  const sj = best.s;
  $("#t-stats").innerHTML = `<div><div class="k">Outputs flagged by agreement</div><div class="v">${pct(sd.share)}</div></div>
    <div><div class="k">Unfaithful outputs caught (agreement)</div><div class="v" style="color:var(--accent)">${pct(sd.catch)}</div></div>
    <div><div class="k">Faithful outputs flagged by mistake</div><div class="v">${pct(sd.fa)}</div></div>
    <div><div class="k">Judge at ${pct(sj.share)} flagged: caught</div><div class="v" style="color:var(--base)">${pct(sj.catch)}</div></div>`;
  // chart
  const host = $("#c-roc"); host.innerHTML = "";
  const Wd = Math.max(300, host.clientWidth || 600), S = Math.min(Wd, 520), m = {l:52, r:14, t:10, b:46}, pw = S - m.l - m.r, ph = Math.min(360, pw);
  const H = ph + m.t + m.b;
  const svg = svgEl("svg", {viewBox:`0 0 ${S} ${H}`, width:S, height:H, role:"img", "aria-label":"Share of unfaithful outputs caught against share of faithful outputs flagged"});
  svg.style.maxWidth = S + "px";
  const X = v => m.l + pw * v, Y = v => m.t + ph * (1 - v);
  const ax = svgEl("g", {class:"axis"}, svg);
  [0, .25, .5, .75, 1].forEach(t => { svgEl("line", {x1:X(t), x2:X(t), y1:Y(0), y2:Y(1), class:"gridl"}, ax); svgEl("line", {x1:X(0), x2:X(1), y1:Y(t), y2:Y(t), class:"gridl"}, ax);
    txt(ax, X(t), Y(0) + 16, (100 * t) + "%", {"text-anchor":"middle"}); txt(ax, X(0) - 6, Y(t) + 4, (100 * t) + "%", {"text-anchor":"end"}); });
  svgEl("line", {x1:X(0), y1:Y(0), x2:X(1), y2:Y(1), stroke:"#8d939c", "stroke-dasharray":"4 3"}, ax);
  txt(ax, X(.5), H - 6, "Faithful outputs flagged (false-flag rate)", {"text-anchor":"middle", fill:"var(--ink)", "font-size":"12.5"});
  const yl = txt(ax, 0, 0, "Unfaithful outputs caught", {"text-anchor":"middle", fill:"var(--ink)", "font-size":"12.5"}); yl.setAttribute("transform", `translate(14 ${Y(.5)}) rotate(-90)`);
  [[rd, "var(--accent)"], [rj, "var(--base)"]].forEach(([rows, c]) => { const p = rocPts(rows); svgEl("polyline", {points:p.map(q => `${X(q.fa)},${Y(q.catch)}`).join(" "), fill:"none", stroke:c, "stroke-width":2.2}, svg); });
  [[sd, "var(--accent)", `Peer agreement below ${T.t.toFixed(2)}`], [sj, "var(--base)", `LLM judge at the nearest flag rate`]].forEach(([s, c, n]) => {
    const g = svgEl("g", {role:"img", "aria-label":`${n}: caught ${pct(s.catch)}, false flags ${pct(s.fa)}`}, svg);
    svgEl("circle", {cx:X(s.fa), cy:Y(s.catch), r:7, fill:c, stroke:"#fff", "stroke-width":2}, g);
    bindTip(g, `<b>${esc(n)}</b><br>flagged ${pct(s.share)} of outputs<br>caught ${pct(s.catch)} of unfaithful<br>flagged ${pct(s.fa)} of faithful<br>precision ${pct(s.prec)}`);
  });
  host.appendChild(svg);
  const diff = sd.catch - sj.catch;
  $("#t-take").textContent = `Flagging the ${pct(sd.share)} of outputs with agreement below ${T.t.toFixed(2)} catches ${pct(sd.catch)} of unfaithful outputs under ${T.fam === "P" ? "panel" : "solver"} labels; the judge, flagging ${pct(sj.share)}, catches ${pct(sj.catch)}` +
    (Math.abs(diff) < 0.005 ? ", about the same." : diff > 0 ? `, ${(100 * diff).toFixed(1)} points fewer.` : `, ${(100 * -diff).toFixed(1)} points more.`);
}
$("#t-range").addEventListener("input", e => { T.t = +e.target.value; drawThr(); });
radioGroup("t-fam", v => { T.fam = v; drawThr(); });

/* ================================================================ SHARED ERROR */
let shSplit = "bad";
function drawShared(){
  const P = ITEMS.filter(it => it.yP != null && (shSplit === "all" || (shSplit === "ok" ? MODEOK[it.sid] === true : MODEOK[it.sid] === false)));
  const rows = [["DC", "Peer agreement", "ours"], ["LCmaj", "Majority equivalence clustering", "other"], ["B1", "LLM judge (gemini-2.5-flash)", "base"]].map(([k, n, c]) => {
    const a = aucOf(P, k, "P"); return {label:n, value:a.auc, cls:c, tip:`<b>${esc(n)}</b><br>AUROC ${f3(a.auc)}<br>${a.n} panel items, ${a.pos} faithful`, _a:a};
  });
  hbars($("#c-shared"), [{rows}], {label:"AUROC in the selected split"});
  const a = rows[0]._a, j = rows[2]._a;
  const nsent = new Set(P.map(it => it.sid)).size;
  $("#sh-take").textContent = shSplit === "bad" ? `In the ${nsent} labelled sentences whose modal cluster is unfaithful (${a.n} items), agreement falls to ${f3(a.auc)}, below chance, while the judge holds ${f3(j.auc)}. It rewards exactly the error most systems made.` :
    shSplit === "ok" ? `Where the modal cluster is faithful (${a.n} items), agreement reaches ${f3(a.auc)} against ${f3(j.auc)} for the judge.` : `Pooled over all ${a.n} panel items: agreement ${f3(a.auc)}, judge ${f3(j.auc)}. Split by the modal cluster to see where the gap comes from.`;
  const box = $("#sh-items"); box.innerHTML = "";
  if ($("#sh-list").checked){
    const wrong = P.filter(it => it.parse && ((it.DC >= 0.5) !== (it.yP === 1))).sort((x, y) => Math.abs(y.DC - y.yP) - Math.abs(x.DC - x.yP));
    let h = `<p class="note">${wrong.length} of ${P.length} items where agreement's verdict at a 0.5 cut disagrees with the panel label. Open one in the item browser to see its peers.</p><div class="tscroll"><table><thead><tr><th>Sentence</th><th>System</th><th>Panel</th><th class="num">Agreement</th><th class="num">Judge</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>`;
    wrong.slice(0, 12).forEach(it => { h += `<tr><td>${esc(SENT[it.sid].text)}</td><td>${esc(it.sys)}</td><td>${labChip(it.yP)}</td><td class="num">${f3(it.DC)}</td><td class="num">${f2(it.B1)}</td><td><button type="button" class="plain" data-open="${it.i}">Open</button></td></tr>`; });
    h += `</tbody></table></div>`;
    box.innerHTML = h;
    box.querySelectorAll("[data-open]").forEach(b => b.addEventListener("click", () => openInBrowser(+b.dataset.open)));
  }
}
radioGroup("sh-split", v => { shSplit = v; drawShared(); });
$("#sh-list").addEventListener("change", drawShared);

/* ================================================================ DOSE */
let doOrder = "random";
function drawDose(){
  const host = $("#c-dose"); host.innerHTML = "";
  const Wd = Math.max(300, host.clientWidth || 600), m = {l:50, r:16, t:12, b:46}, pw = Wd - m.l - m.r, ph = 240, H = ph + m.t + m.b;
  const svg = svgEl("svg", {viewBox:`0 0 ${Wd} ${H}`, width:Wd, height:H, role:"img", "aria-label":"Detection against number of peers replaced"});
  const X = k => m.l + pw * k / 8, Y = v => m.t + ph * (1 - v);
  const ax = svgEl("g", {class:"axis"}, svg);
  [0, 2, 4, 6, 8].forEach(k => { svgEl("line", {x1:X(k), x2:X(k), y1:Y(0), y2:Y(1), class:"gridl"}, ax); txt(ax, X(k), Y(0) + 16, String(k), {"text-anchor":"middle"}); });
  [0, .25, .5, .75, 1].forEach(v => { svgEl("line", {x1:X(0), x2:X(8), y1:Y(v), y2:Y(v), class:"gridl"}, ax); txt(ax, X(0) - 6, Y(v) + 4, v.toFixed(2), {"text-anchor":"end"}); });
  svgEl("line", {x1:X(0), x2:X(8), y1:Y(.5), y2:Y(.5), stroke:"#8d939c", "stroke-dasharray":"4 3"}, ax);
  txt(ax, X(4), H - 6, "k: peers replaced by renamed copies of the mutant (of 8)", {"text-anchor":"middle", fill:"var(--ink)", "font-size":"12.5"});
  const yl = txt(ax, 0, 0, "Detection", {"text-anchor":"middle", fill:"var(--ink)", "font-size":"12.5"}); yl.setAttribute("transform", `translate(13 ${Y(.5)}) rotate(-90)`);
  const D = DOSE.order[doOrder], series = [["noL3", "No granularity definitions (observed)", "var(--accent)", false]];
  if ($("#do-an").checked) series.push(["analytic", "Predicted from peer weight alone (development configuration)", "var(--base)", true]);
  $("#do-legend").innerHTML = series.map(s => `<span style="--c:${s[2]}">${esc(s[1])}</span>`).join("");
  series.forEach(([k, n, c, dash]) => {

  solver:["Audited solver labels", "The panel first audits each shipped gold. A candidate is faithful if the SMT solver proves it equivalent to the audited gold under an arity-preserving bijection of predicates and constants, searched without lexical information. 3,720 fresh rows."],
  judge:["LLM judge", "gemini-2.5-flash, thinking off, temperature 0, asked for the probability that the formula is faithful to the sentence. The frontier judge is gemini-2.5-pro with the same prompt."],
  dsbin:["Binary Dawid–Skene agreement", "A Dawid–Skene posterior with two classes over the same equivalence clusters; an existing latent-class estimator."],
  maj:["Majority equivalence clustering", "The share of other outputs in the candidate's cluster of outputs equivalent under a bijection, after Li et al. (2024)."],
  vc:["Vocabulary conformity control", "The mean of the Jaccard overlap of predicate names with the peers and the agreement of arity profiles with the peers. It tests whether agreement merely rewards conventional names."],
  rt:["Roundtrip", "Back-translation of the formula to English, compared with the sentence by DeBERTa-v3 NLI or by MiniLM cosine similarity. (L) marks back-translation by a local Qwen3-8B model."],
  struct:["Structural consistency metrics", "Joint loadability, arity consistency within a formula and within a document, and undefined predicates: the stability checks common in NL→FOL pilots. Parse rate is reported separately."],
  gran:["Granularity definitions", "A component evaluated and left out of the score: it lets one predicate stand for a conjunction of at most two literals of the other formula."],
  incr:["Incremental AUROC", "The gain in AUROC, computed on held-out folds, when a score is added to a logistic regression fitted by cross-validation over a fixed base, with folds grouped by sentence."],
  mutant:["Mutant", "A perturbed formula that is not logically equivalent to the gold, made by an operator such as negation, an added or dropped conjunct, a ∀/∃ swap, implication reversal or argument swap."],
  dose:["Dose test", "A controlled test in which k of the eight peers are replaced by renamed copies of a mutant, measuring how often the faithful formula still scores above the mutant."],
  conc:["Concordance within sentences", "The probability that a faithful output scores above an unfaithful output of the same sentence."],

minmax(0,3fr)}}\ndl.gloss dt{font-weight:650}\ndl.gloss dd{margin:0 0 8px;color:var(--ink2)}\n.prov
